sunoData.title: Moss Coin Continue
sunoData.tags: Chiptune-inspired ambient fantasy with a gentle 92 BPM pulse, soft arpeggiated bells, warm synth bass, and looped chord movement that feels like failure turning into another chance; the verse state drifts through sparse melodies, the midsection adds a tender counterline and quiet octave shimmer, and the final pass folds back into the opening with seamless game-over/retry logic. Feather-light vocal-like pads, tiny coin jingles, reverse swells, and rounded sidechain breathing. Clean, pastel, and emotionally bittersweet., tone, gentle, soft, harmony, emotional
